title: lora_recv_async 4.1.0 migration: lr1110.c driver
description: Child 4 of 0l5j. Migrate lichen/drivers/lora/lr1110/lr1110.c recv_async (lr1110.c:814) to the Zephyr 4.x 3-arg contract (cb gains void *user_data; store and pass it from the DIO9 RX_DONE path). Use the shared compat macros from lichen/include/lichen/lora_compat.h (added in 0l5j.1). Real hardware: compile-verify via the lr1110 board build target; runtime needs bench access per docs/bench-operations.md.
